intentEvidence: Days Left solves this by: - Making time visible: See exactly how many days remain
problem: Static dates in notes are easily overlooked, making it difficult to track deadlines or milestones without constant manual checking.
summary: Days Left is a customizable countdown and count-up timer that tracks time remaining until future events or time passed since past dates directly within Obsidian notes.
